checks.result: The Korean Ministry of Foreign Affairs states that the Blueprint for Action was officially endorsed as the outcome document of the 2024 REAIM Summit, supported by 61 States. It is described as a declarative document setting out principles and governance directions for responsible military AI.

The official PDF was downloaded from the ministry page. It is an image-only three-page document; the text layer is empty, so the content was verified from the official press release and the published summary, not from OCR.
The Blueprint is a political outcome document. It has no treaty, signature, ratification, depositary or entry-into-force clause.
